definitions.explanation: A personal computer, especially a desktop or laptop. Commonly used abbreviation in Japanese.

examples.english: I use a PC for work.

examples.japanese: PCが{故障|こしょう}したので{修理|しゅうり}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: My PC broke down, so I sent it for repair.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of English 'personal computer'. Standard term in Japanese for desktop and laptop computers.

USAGE:
Very common in:
・Business contexts
・Technology discussions
・Everyday conversation

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・PC{操作|そうさ} - PC operation
・PCゲーム - PC game
・PC{版|ばん} - PC version

COLLOCATIONS:
・PCを{起動|きどう}する - to start up a PC
・PCを{再起動|さいきどう}する - to restart a PC
・PCに{保存|ほぞん}する - to save to PC
